name: randerr
comment: MATLAB randerr: random binary error matrix with controllable error count per row. Uses MatlabMT19937 for bit-equal output with MATLAB R2025b on seeded inputs. Covered: scalar (1 error), scalar (3 errors), vector [1 2 3] uniform, weighted [0 1 2; 0.0 0.7 0.3]. All known column placements + row sums fingerprinted. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship randerr in core; reports N/A.
